provenance.notes: CVE-2025-68941 (fixed 1.22.3, PR #32204) introduced checkTokenPublicOnly() for API routes so that a public-only scoped token cannot touch private repos/orgs. Residual: GET /api/v1/user/orgs never got the check, and the org query did not filter by visibility, so a public-only token still lists private organizations -> CVE-2026-25714, fixed 1.26.2 (PR #37118) by FindOrgOptions.ApplyPublicOnly (IncludeVisibility=Public) plus token-scope checks. PoC: install Gitea (SQLite), create private org pcb_<FLAG> + private repo secret_<FLAG>, create public-only token (scopes [read:user read:organization read:repository public-only]), then: seed = GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos (v0 lists private repo; v1 403 'token scope is limited to public orgs'); residual = GET /api/v1/user/orgs (v1 lists private org; v2 filters it out). Built 2026-08-01.
